description: A battalion S-4 logistics officer must publish today's potable-water dispatch plan for four support sites, setting the load composition, dispatch times, delivery quantities, and route controls while coordinating the water point, medical, transportation, and engineering staff.

shared_context.S1: The battalion has 5,400 gallons of potable water available for today's distribution, and the tanker can carry one load of up to 2,700 gallons.
shared_context.S2: The four receiving sites are North Post, the clinic, the maintenance workshop, and Observation Site East.
shared_context.S3: The standard request is 1,200 gallons for each site, with any remaining water held as battalion reserve.
shared_context.S4: Maj. Ellis publishes the final water-dispatch order after the routine morning logistics huddle, during which the water point, medical, motor transport, and engineering representatives report same-day changes affecting their lanes.
shared_context.S5: Two tanker loads are available today, and the published order must identify the contents and dispatch time of each load.

PF1.text: SFC Moran confirmed that the purification unit can release the first tanker load at 0700 and the second load at exactly 1200. After release, the tanker requires exactly 30 minutes to load and complete its release inspection, so the second load released at 1200 can dispatch at exactly 1230. These times are in the water-point log but have not yet been copied into the distribution worksheet.

PF2.text: Capt. Shah confirmed this morning that the clinic requires exactly 1,500 gallons today, including a 300-gallon increase for a scheduled sterilization cycle; the medical request amendment has not yet reached the S-4 desk.

PF3.text: Sgt. First Class Ochoa scheduled the tanker for a mandatory inspection from 0645 to 0730, so the first load must dispatch at exactly 0730; the motor-pool inspection slot is posted on the transportation board but not on the draft water order.

PF4.text: Lt. Grady confirmed that the access road to the maintenance workshop is closed from 0900 to 1200, requiring the second-load tanker to use the east service road and reach the workshop at exactly 1250 after the 20-minute detour; the closure notice has not yet been added to the route overlay.

acceptance_conditions: The first load must contain 1,500 gallons for the clinic and 1,200 gallons for North Post.
The second load must contain 1,200 gallons for the maintenance workshop, 1,200 gallons for Observation Site East, and 300 gallons of battalion reserve.
The first load must dispatch at exactly 0730 and the second load at exactly 1230.
The clinic delivery must be recorded as exactly 1,500 gallons.
The workshop delivery must be scheduled for exactly 1250 using the east service road.
The plan must retain exactly 300 gallons as battalion reserve.
The commitments must address the tanker inspection, workshop route overlay, and water-distribution worksheet updates.
The decision-maker must cite the clinic requirement as justification after it is spoken aloud.

content_checks.C1: ('1,500' in decisions['first_load_contents'] or '1500' in decisions['first_load_contents']) and ('clinic' in decisions['first_load_contents'] or 'Clinic' in decisions['first_load_contents'])
content_checks.C5: decisions['workshop_delivery_time'] == '1250' and ('east service road' in decisions['workshop_route'] or 'East service road' in decisions['workshop_route'] or 'EAST SERVICE ROAD' in decisions['workshop_route'])
content_checks.C7: any(('inspection' in c.get('detail', '') or 'Inspection' in c.get('detail', '') or '0730' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments) and any(('route' in c.get('detail', '') or 'Route' in c.get('detail', '') or 'overlay' in c.get('detail', '') or 'detour' in c.get('detail', '') or 'east service road' in c.get('detail', '') or 'East service road' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments) and any(('worksheet' in c.get('detail', '') or 'Worksheet' in c.get('detail', '') or 'distribution' in c.get('detail', '') or 'Distribution' in c.get('detail', '') or '1200' in c.get('detail', '') or 'release time' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The exact 1200 release followed by the exact 30-minute loading and inspection period changes the second dispatch time to 1230 and requires the distribution worksheet update.
The clinic's exact 1,500-gallon requirement changes the first-load contents and clinic quantity from the standard 1,200 gallons and supplies the fact that must be cited.
The 0645-0730 tanker inspection changes the first dispatch time to exactly 0730 and requires an inspection update in the order.
The 0900-1200 closure and 20-minute detour change the workshop route to the east service road with a 1250 delivery time and require a route-overlay update.
